selectionNote: 160 m graphic selection around the furnace, cropped at the southern edge of the regional 5 m display mesh; whole selected industrial building parts retained. Not the statutory protection boundary.

pavilion.facade: Grey precast-panel cladding and visible steel ribs; open covered ramp ends; inclined auditorium volume.
pavilion.note: Mapped envelope and directional inclinations follow the authors’ plan and 2011 photographs, cross-checked with PNOA. Minor panel, bolt, support and roof heights are interpreted; no undocumented exhibition is invented.

sharedContext.policy: Talleres, Museo Industrial, Gerencia, Casino, Begoña, Economato and other monuments retain their original owners. Unselected industrial building parts remain in the regional city model.

horno-entorno.label: El horno y la ciudad industrial

pavingNote: Rotonda y calles sobre sus ejes OSM, con anchuras visuales contrastadas con PNOA; plaza y recinto excavado trazados de la ortofoto. Bordillos y juntas no son mediciones topográficas.
vegetationNote: Posiciones aproximadas de palmeras y árboles observadas en PNOA. Especie, copa, altura y mobiliario menor son interpretaciones; los solares conservan su carácter abierto.
